currentUserGoal: Investigate slowdown when the field reaches the screenshot-sized midgame state and optimize the specific trigger path causing hitches.
changesMade: Profiled the existing perf harness at 237 and 1200 stress tiles before changing code.

Added adaptive batch redraw pressure limits in GameScene so medium and large batch-mode fields schedule smaller dirty-tile redraw bursts once effect quality, object pressure, viewport size, or recent frame spikes indicate pressure.
Reduced common render texture stamping per frame under pressure from 8 tiles / 1.6ms to 4 tiles / 0.9ms.
Reduced dirty live tile view buildup under pressure from the normal batch limits to 24 desktop tiles or 16 compact/tablet tiles.

verificationRun.result: Detected the target burst: maxFrameDeltaMs 38, frameSpikes 7, maxStale 45, maxStamps 62, max displayObjects 343.

knownIssues: At 1200 desktop stress tiles, the adaptive budget can leave common redraw queue work visible in the idle harness sample. This is intentional spreading rather than a stuck queue; it cleared by the next harness phase.
The in-app browser screenshot API timed out in this thread, so profiling used the local Chrome executable through Playwright after the in-app harness check failed to publish the dataset.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play-test the real save around 220-300 patches and watch the perf overlay during sprinkler, companion, mutation, and hazard bursts.

If hitches persist on an actual phone or tablet, profile the companion/sprinkler visual path next; the common redraw burst is now smaller, but world action effects can still add transient display objects.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old fixed 8-tile common redraw budget without rerunning the 237-tile trigger watch.
Do not treat the unrelated dirty files in AGENTS.md, docs/, or the older handoff as part of this performance change.
